subject: Gold Skulltula 088
text: A Gold Skulltula is found on the northern target at night.

evidence.quote: Play the Sun's Song to make it night time.  Ride the horse to the north end and you will see that there is a GOLD SKULLTULA [088] on the northern target.

subject: Gerudo Training Ground
text: A Gerudo woman allows entry to the Gerudo Training Ground for 10 Rupees.

evidence.quote: Speak to her and she'll let you into the Gerudo Training Ground for a mere 10 Rupees, it's totally optional.

subject: Blue Rupee
text: Shooting the eyeball switch above the entrance door spawns a chest containing a Blue Rupee.

evidence.quote: above the door where you entered there is an eyeball switch, fire an arrow at it to spawn a small chest containing BLUE RUPEE.

subject: Small Key
text: Defeating the two Stalfos within the one minute time limit spawns a chest containing a Small Key.

evidence.quote: There are two Stalfos enemies in this room and you need to defeat them before the time limit of one minute runs out, obviously make sure you're using the Biggoron's Sword for this.  After killing them both a chest appears containing SMALL KEY, pick it up and go through the door beside the chest to enter the next hall.

subject: Silver Rupees
text: You must collect all five Silver Rupees within one minute and thirty seconds.

evidence.quote: In here you have one minute and thirty seconds to collect all the Silver Rupees....The fifth Silver Rupee is located at the top of this hill.

subject: Arrows
text: Defeating the four wolf enemies causes a small chest containing Arrows to appear.

evidence.quote: Defeat the four wolf enemies in this room and then open the small chest appears to get a bunch of ARROWS.

subject: Small Key
text: Shooting all four statue eyes in a circle causes a chest containing a Small Key to appear.

evidence.quote: Shoot the eyeball of the statue and make your way around from left to right in a circle, shooting the eyeballs as you go along.  When all four of them are lit up a chest appears containing a SMALL KEY.

subject: Small Key
text: Smashing the statues with the Megaton Hammer, shooting the eye switch, and stepping on the button allows you to open a chest for a Small Key.

evidence.quote: After doing this equip the megaton Hammer and smash all the statues at the sides of the room.  Shoot the eyeball switch to unlock the door and step on the button to lower the fire in the middle and allow you to open the chest for a SMALL KEY.

subject: Small Key
text: Playing the Song of Time, diving with Iron Boots, and collecting the underwater Silver Rupees rewards a Small Key from a small chest.

evidence.quote: Play the Song of Time (right, A, down, right, A, down) and they will disappear.  Equip the Iron Boots and drop down the hole to the bottom.  Your goal is to collect all the Silver Rupees and it will make it a lot easier if you defeat the enemies first....When this is over, swim back up to the top and open the small chest to acquire the fourth SMALL KEY.

subject: Small Key
text: Defeating the two lizard enemies and bombing the laser pillar reveals a chest containing a Small Key.

evidence.quote: When the two lizards are defeated, bomb the laser pillar and a chest appears with a SMALL KEY in it.

subject: Small Key
text: Playing the Song of Time on the button platform summons blocks to climb up to a Small Key.

evidence.quote: Play the Song of Time (right, A, down, right, A, down) and some blocks will appear here.  use the Hover Boots to reach them and climb up.  Grab the sixth SMALL KEY and go through the door.

subject: Arrows
text: Making a right leads to a chest containing Arrows.

evidence.quote: Make a right here and it leads to a chest containing ARROWS.

subject: Bombchu
text: Directly across from the door is a chest with a Bombchu inside.

evidence.quote: Directly across from the door where you entered is a chest with a BOMBCHU in it.

subject: Purple Rupee
text: Unlocking the first two locked doors on the left leads to a chest with a Purple Rupee.

evidence.quote: use two Small Keys to go through the locked door on your left and then the one after it as well, now you're down to four.  Open the chest to get a PURPLE RUPEE here.

subject: Red Rupee
text: Continuing through the next two locked doors reveals a small chest containing a Red Rupee.

evidence.quote: Continue through the next locked door and the one after it, open the small chest containing a RED RUPEE.

subject: Arrows
text: Passing through the next door leads to a chest containing Arrows.

evidence.quote: Continue through the next door and open the chest to get ARROWS.

subject: Small Key
text: Climbing the fence wall into the ceiling hole found using the Lens of Truth leads to a chest containing a Small Key.

evidence.quote: Proceed through the door on the left which you unlocked and take a look at the ceiling with the Lens of Truth equipped, there is a hole up there.  Climb the fence wall and here you will find a chest containing a SMALL KEY.

subject: Ice Arrow
text: Inside the giant chest at the end of the locked room is the Ice Arrow.

evidence.quote: Inside the giant chest is the ICE ARROW, like the Fire Arrow it is a special elemental type of arrow you can shoot using the Fairy Bow.

subject: Bombchu
text: A carpet merchant in the desert sells Bombchus for 200 Rupees.

evidence.quote: Follow it and equip the Hover Boots, they will allow you to run onto the magic carpet and speak to the guy.  He sells Bombchus for 200 Rupees, not worth it, but whatever.

subject: Gold Skulltula 089
text: Gold Skulltula 089 is located inside the small stone structure in the Haunted Wasteland.

evidence.quote: When you reach a small stone structure, drop down.  Defeat the GOLD SKULLTULA [089] there and then equip the Fire Arrows.

subject: Purple Rupee
text: Lighting both torches inside the stone structure with Fire Arrows spawns a chest containing a Purple Rupee.

evidence.quote: Use them to light both torches in this room and spawn a small chest with a PURPLE RUPEE inside.

subject: Nayru's Love
text: Bombing the cracked wall between two trees reveals a Great Fairy Fountain where you learn Nayru's Love by playing Zelda's Lullaby on the Triforce emblem.

evidence.quote: Begin by heading north and taking a look between two trees for a wall with a crack in it.  Bomb this wall to reveal a Great Fairy Fountain, somewhere you haven't been in a long time.  This is where you will learn the third spell, Naryu's Love.  Prove your royal connections by standing on the Triforce emblem and playing Zelda's Lullaby.

subject: Gold Skulltula 090
text: Gold Skulltula 090 is on the back of the palm tree at night across from the dry oasis.

evidence.quote: Take a look on the back of the palm tree across from you at night, there is a GOLD SKULLTULA [090] on the back of it.

subject: Requiem of Spirit
text: Leaving the Spirit Temple triggers a scene where Sheik teaches you the Requiem of Spirit.

evidence.quote: Leave the temple for a scene.  Sheik will teach you the REQUIEM OF SPIRIT.

subject: Gold Skulltula 091
text: Dropping bugs into the hole in front of the Spirit Temple entrance reveals Gold Skulltula 091.

evidence.quote: In front of the door to the temple there is a hole there.  Drop your bugs into the hole to find GOLD SKULLTULA [091].

subject: Gold Skulltula 092
text: Riding the Magic Bean plant at night takes you across Gold Skulltula 092 on top of a large rock mound.

evidence.quote: step on the Magic Bean plant.  Make sure it's night time, about half way through its flight you'll come across GOLD SKULLTULA [092] on top of a large rock mound.

subject: Piece of Heart 034
text: Piece of Heart 034 is located on top of the arch in front of the entrance near the end of the Magic Bean flight.

evidence.quote: Near the end of the flight, on top of the arch in front of the entrance is PIECE OF HEART [034].

subject: Blue Rupee
text: Hitting the crystal with the Boomerang lowers the bridge and gives access to a chest containing a Blue Rupee.

evidence.quote: Stand at the edge and equip the Boomerang.  Aim for the left side of the room and throw, it should come back around and hit the crystal on the other side.  This will cause the bridge to fall down.  Open the chest for a BLUE RUPPE and go through the door.

subject: Anubis
text: Anubis is weak to fire and can be engulfed in flames by shooting the crystal with the Slingshot when it is standing in front of the door.

evidence.quote: The enemy is weak to fire.  Notice that on the right side there is a crystal that when hit, creates fire in front of the door.  What you have to do is run to the middle of the room and jump to the left so the other enemy is standing in front of the door.  Shoot the crystal from here with your Slingshot and it will engulf Anubis in flames.

subject: Gold Skulltula 093
text: Collecting all five Silver Rupees lowers the bridge, allowing you to reach Gold Skulltula 093 with the Boomerang.

evidence.quote: When you have all five the bridge drops down.  Go to the other side of the room and use your Boomerang to get GOLD SKULLTULA [093].

subject: Small Key
text: Lighting both torches with Din's Fire allows you to open a chest containing a Small Key.

evidence.quote: Since you can't use the Fire Arrows as Young Link, you'll have to ignite both of the torches here using the Din’s Fire spell.  Turn around and open the chest to get a SMALL KEY and then proceed through the door on the same side as the torches you ignited.

subject: Gold Skulltula 094
text: At the top of the climbable wall, looking down reveals Gold Skulltula 094 on the wall, obtainable with the Boomerang.

evidence.quote: At the very top, turn around and look down to see a GOLD SKULLTULA [094] on the wall, get it with the Boomerang.

subject: Bombchu
text: Hitting the crystal on the side of the room spawns a chest containing a Bombchu.

evidence.quote: Look up at the side of the room to see a crystal, hit it and a chest appears containing a BOMBCHU, there should also be another chest here with a BLUE RUPEE in it.

subject: Blue Rupee
text: Hitting the crystal on the side of the room also reveals another chest containing a Blue Rupee.

evidence.quote: Look up at the side of the room to see a crystal, hit it and a chest appears containing a BOMBCHU, there should also be another chest here with a BLUE RUPEE in it.
